## Welcome {.unnumbered}

These are the class notes for **CE/ME 507: Finite Element Methods**, one chapter per class
period.

The notes move from a pair of concrete engineering problems — a loaded beam and a heated
circuit board — to the boundary value problem they share, then build the full machinery to
solve such problems approximately: the strong and weak forms (and their equivalence in both
directions), the Galerkin method, basis functions and Lagrange polynomials, the resulting
discrete matrix system, element-wise assembly and sparsity, the isoparametric map and its
Jacobian, and finally quadrature and assembly on a real mesh via the IEN array.

Figures are generated programmatically rather than scanned, and the worked results are
computed on the page so that the text and the drawings always agree.
